document.title: A neighborhood book club for everyone
document.author: Demo Contributor
document.summary: A friendly book club brings neighbors together through reading and conversation.
document.content: Our neighborhood book club meets once a month. Each reader brings a favorite passage and a question. We make time for everyone to share, even if they have not finished the book. A simple welcome and a shared story can help a new neighbor feel at home.
